In detail

A residential district built around Viale Forze Armate. Local news documents a bar that became a known drug-dealing spot after closing during Covid, a shooting following a dispute over an unpaid bill, and police clearing squatted ex-military warehouses in the area. Localised, documented issues rather than widespread danger, supporting added caution after dark; daytime the area is an ordinary residential quarter.
